This '''Ewok sentry''', who wore what appeared to be an inverted animal [[Bone/Legends|skull]] atop his head, was among the members of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] present when the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] were brought to the village. The Ewok later listened to [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO's]] tale from [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa's]] side.<ref name="RotJ" />
